title.narrative: EU for Clean Air - North Macedonia

description.narrative: The project "EU for Clean Air" aims to contribute towards reduced emissions of pollutants and particulate matter in the cities most affected by air and environmental pollution. Through improving the heating systems in 70 public buildings in Skopje, Bitola, Kumanovo and Tetovo and providing six environmentally friendly buses for the city of Skopje, as well as 6,000 tree seedlings planted in the four cities. As part of the project, the Skopje District Heating System will be further expanded, and air quality monitoring stations will be delivered and installed.
